entities.summary: Alexander MacDonald "Sandy" Keith was an American politician and jurist who was the first person to hold office in each of the three branches of Minnesota state government, serving as state senator, the 37th lieutenant governor of Minnesota, and as an associate justice and later chief justice of the Minnesota Supreme Court.
